description: Queue a free text-to-image task from a complete scene description. Each task is independent, not an edit of a previous image. Returns a job ID; poll get_studio_job then get_studio_image for the PNG. Configured model and size appear in service status/results. No external AI fallback.

access_token.description: Private token from create_trial_access; optional with Bearer authentication.

consent.description: Confirm permission to process this nonconfidential content.

prompt.description: Complete image description. English prompts are recommended.

name: submit_image_job
title: Generate an image on the GPU
